audio.t: Attention, passengers on Pacifica Air flight 218 to Vancouver.
Due to a mechanical inspection of the aircraft, boarding has been delayed.
The new departure time is four forty-five p.m., about an hour later than scheduled.
Passengers who would like to rebook onto a later flight should visit the service counter near Gate 12.
In addition, all passengers on this flight will receive a ten-dollar coupon to use at any restaurant in the terminal.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

questions.q: Why is the flight delayed?
questions.explain: Thông báo nói rõ 'Due to a mechanical inspection of the aircraft, boarding has been delayed'.

questions.q: How long is the delay?
questions.explain: Giờ khởi hành mới là 4:45 p.m., 'about an hour later than scheduled'.

questions.q: What will passengers receive?
questions.explain: Hành khách nhận 'a ten-dollar coupon to use at any restaurant in the terminal'.

audio.t: Hello, Mr. Bennett. This is Laura Chen from Sunrise Office Supplies, returning your call about the order for twelve ergonomic chairs.
I'm afraid the black model you requested is out of stock until the end of the month.
We do have the same chair in gray, and I can offer a five percent discount if you choose that color.
If you'd rather wait for the black one, I can reserve them for you today.
Please call me back at extension 214 before noon tomorrow, since the gray chairs are selling quickly.
Thank you.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To discuss a problem with an order
questions.explain: Cô gọi lại về đơn hàng ghế và báo mẫu màu đen đang hết hàng, tức có vấn đề với đơn hàng.

questions.q: What does the speaker offer?
options: A discount on a different color
questions.explain: Cô nói 'the same chair in gray... five percent discount if you choose that color'. Không phải đổi sang mẫu khác mà là đổi màu.

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do by tomorrow noon?
questions.explain: Cô dặn 'Please call me back at extension 214 before noon tomorrow'.

audio.t: Good morning, everyone. Before we start our shifts, I have a few updates.
First, a travel company will arrive with sixty guests at two o'clock today, so we'll need extra staff at the front desk during check-in.
Second, the elevator on the east side is being repaired this week, so please direct guests to use the main elevators.
Finally, starting Monday, we're introducing a new mobile check-in system.
Mr. Alvarez from the IT department will lead a training session tomorrow at eight.
Please make sure you attend.

questions.q: Who is the speaker addressing?
questions.explain: Người nói nhắc đến 'our shifts', 'front desk', 'direct guests', nên đối tượng là nhân viên khách sạn.

questions.q: What will happen at two o'clock?
options: A group of travelers will arrive
A new system will be launched
questions.explain: 'A travel company will arrive with sixty guests at two o'clock today'. Buổi tập huấn là ngày mai lúc 8 giờ.

questions.q: What are the listeners asked to do?
questions.explain: Kết thúc bài nói: 'Please make sure you attend' (buổi tập huấn của ông Alvarez).

audio.t: Are you looking for the latest in business technology?
Come visit the Digital Solutions Expo, held at the Riverside Convention Center from May ninth to eleventh.
Over two hundred exhibitors will showcase everything from cloud software to smart office equipment.
Each day features free workshops led by industry experts, including a popular session on cybersecurity.
Admission is free if you register online before April thirtieth. Otherwise, tickets cost twenty dollars at the door.
To sign up, visit digitalsolutionsexpo dot com.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo nói về 'Digital Solutions Expo' với hơn 200 nhà trưng bày công nghệ.

questions.q: What can attendees do for free each day?
questions.explain: 'Each day features free workshops led by industry experts'.

questions.q: How can listeners avoid paying for admission?
questions.explain: Vào cửa miễn phí 'if you register online before April thirtieth', tức đăng ký trước.

audio.t: Welcome back to Taste of the Town, the show that brings you the best in local dining.
This week, we're featuring the Harvest Table, a new restaurant that opened last month on Elm Street.
The chef, Isabel Moreno, uses ingredients from farms within fifty miles of the city, and the menu changes with the seasons.
Many diners say the roasted pumpkin soup is the highlight.
The restaurant is open for dinner Tuesday through Sunday, and reservations are strongly recommended, especially on weekends.
Stay tuned after the break, when Chef Moreno joins me in the studio to share one of her recipes.

questions.q: What is the broadcast mainly about?
questions.explain: Chương trình giới thiệu Harvest Table, 'a new restaurant that opened last month'.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the restaurant's ingredients?
questions.explain: Đầu bếp dùng nguyên liệu 'from farms within fifty miles of the city', tức nguồn địa phương.

questions.q: What will happen after the break?
options: A chef will share a recipe
A contest winner will be announced
A weather report will be given
questions.explain: 'Chef Moreno joins me in the studio to share one of her recipes'.

audio.t: Looking for the perfect place to call home?
Welcome to Cedar Heights, a new community of townhouses just fifteen minutes from downtown.
Each home features three bedrooms, a private garden, and a two-car garage.
Residents also enjoy access to a clubhouse, a swimming pool, and walking trails.
Prices start at three hundred and ten thousand dollars, and the first twenty buyers will receive free kitchen appliances.
Visit our sales office this weekend between ten and four, or call 555-0134 to schedule a private tour.

questions.q: What type of property is being advertised?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo giới thiệu 'a new community of townhouses'.

questions.q: What will the first buyers receive?
questions.explain: 'The first twenty buyers will receive free kitchen appliances'.

questions.q: What can listeners do this weekend?
questions.explain: 'Visit our sales office this weekend between ten and four'.

audio.t: Welcome to the training video for our new project management software.
In this short session, I'll show you how to create a project and invite your team members.
First, click the green New Project button in the upper left corner.
Give your project a name and choose a due date. You can change both later if the schedule changes.
Next, select Team from the menu to send invitations by e-mail. Each team member will get a link, and they'll need to create a password.
If you have any questions, you can find answers in the Help Center, or you can start a live chat with our support staff at any time.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the talk?
options: To explain how to use a program
questions.explain: Người nói mở đầu: 'I'll show you how to create a project and invite your team members' bằng phần mềm quản lý dự án.

questions.q: According to the speaker, what can be changed later?
options: A project's name and due date
questions.explain: 'Give your project a name and choose a due date. You can change both later'.

questions.q: What are listeners encouraged to do if they have questions?
questions.explain: Anh nói có thể 'start a live chat with our support staff at any time', tức dùng dịch vụ chat trực tuyến.

audio.t: Good afternoon, attendees of the Global Marketing Summit. Please note a change to this afternoon's program.
Because of a scheduling conflict, Dr. Patel's presentation on consumer trends has been moved from Room A to the Garden Hall.
It will now begin at three-thirty instead of three o'clock.
In the meantime, the coffee break will be extended by thirty minutes, and refreshments are available on the second floor.
Finally, if you left a black laptop bag near the registration desk, please see a staff member at the information booth.

questions.q: Where is the announcement most likely being made?
questions.explain: Thông báo gửi tới 'attendees of the Global Marketing Summit', một sự kiện kinh doanh.

questions.q: What has changed about Dr. Patel's presentation?
questions.explain: Bài thuyết trình chuyển từ Room A sang Garden Hall và bắt đầu lúc 3:30 thay vì 3:00.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do if they lost an item?
questions.explain: 'Please see a staff member at the information booth' nếu để quên túi xách.

audio.t: In business news, Harmon Electronics announced today that it will open a new manufacturing plant in the town of Westfield.
The company plans to hire about four hundred workers over the next two years.
Mayor Gloria Santos welcomed the news, saying the plant will help revitalize the local economy.
Construction is expected to begin in March, with production starting early next year.
In related news, the city council will hold a public meeting on Thursday evening to discuss improvements to local roads and public transportation near the site.
Residents are encouraged to attend.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the report?
options: A company's plan to build a factory
questions.explain: Bản tin nói Harmon Electronics sẽ mở nhà máy sản xuất mới ở Westfield.

questions.q: What does the mayor say about the plant?
options: It will help the local economy
questions.explain: Thị trưởng nói nhà máy 'will help revitalize the local economy', tức giúp phục hồi kinh tế địa phương.

questions.q: What will happen on Thursday?
options: The mayor will give a speech
A public meeting will be held
questions.explain: 'The city council will hold a public meeting on Thursday evening'. Việc xây dựng bắt đầu vào tháng Ba.

audio.t: Thank you for calling the Zenith Technology help desk. Our office hours are Monday through Friday, eight a.m. to six p.m.
If you're calling about a problem with your Internet service, please press one.
For billing questions, press two. For new installations, press three.
Please note that, due to high call volume, wait times are longer than usual.
You may also visit our website and use the virtual assistant for immediate help.
If this is an emergency, such as a complete service outage in your building, stay on the line and a representative will help you right away.

questions.q: What kind of business is the caller reaching?
questions.explain: Tên 'Zenith Technology help desk' và các lựa chọn về dịch vụ Internet, lắp đặt cho thấy đây là công ty dịch vụ công nghệ.

questions.q: What should a caller press for billing questions?
questions.explain: 'For billing questions, press two'. Một là sự cố Internet, ba là lắp đặt mới.

questions.q: What can callers do to get immediate help?
questions.explain: 'Visit our website and use the virtual assistant for immediate help'.
